title: Playing for Lula White and Tony Jackson in the mansions
summary: Picou played clarinet and piano in the front parlor at Lula White's; talk of Tony Jackson's tunes, Jelly Roll Morton, hours and no shows.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene
